paper.title_en: Mapping Schwarzschild Spacetime: From Kruskal to Diamond and Golden Representations
paper.abstract_en: We present several representations of the Schwarzschild spacetime. Some of these are classical, such as the embedding, Tortoise, and Kruskal representations. The latter two motivate the introduction of pulsating coordinates (or the Diamond representation), a compact approach recently proposed for spherically symmetric static metrics. We then introduce the Golden representation for the Schwarzschild spacetime, where what we call the Fibonacci metric, and the golden ratio, become ubiquitous. We conclude by offering some visual and physical interpretations of this approach.
